See also: comédia, comedía, and comèdia

Galician

[edit]
Galician Wikipedia has an article on:
comedia
Wikipedia gl

Etymology 1

[edit]

From Latin cōmoedia, from Ancient Greek κωμῳδία (kōmōidía).

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /koˈmedja/ [koˈme.ð̞jɐ]
    • Rhymes: -edja
  • IPA(key): /koˈmɛdja/ [koˈmɛ.ð̞jɐ]
    • Rhymes: -ɛdja
  • Hyphenation: co‧me‧dia

Noun

[edit]

comedia f (plural comedias)

  1. comedy
    Antonym: traxedia
Derived terms
[edit]
  • comediante m
  • comedia de situación f
Related terms
[edit]
  • cómico

Etymology 2

[edit]

Verb

[edit]

comedia

  1. (reintegrationist norm) first/third-person singular imperfect indicative of comedir

Further reading

[edit]
  • “comedia”, in Dicionario da Real Academia Galega (in Galician), A Coruña: Royal Galician Academy, 2012–2026

Italian

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /koˈmɛ.dja/[1][2]
    • Rhymes: -ɛdja
    • Hyphenation: co‧mè‧dia
  • IPA(key): (careful style, Old Italian) /ko.meˈdi.a/[1][2]
    • Rhymes: -ia
    • Hyphenation: co‧me‧dì‧a

Noun

[edit]

comedia f (plural comedie) (archaic)[1]

  1. alternative form of commedia

See also

[edit]
  • tragedia

References

[edit]
  1. ↑ 1.0 1.1 1.2 comedia → commedia in Bruno Migliorini et al., Dizionario d'ortografia e di pronunzia, Rai Eri, 2025
  2. ↑ 2.0 2.1 comedia in Luciano Canepari, Dizionario di Pronuncia Italiana (DiPI)

Spanish

[edit]
Spanish Wikipedia has an article on:
comedia
Wikipedia es

Etymology

[edit]

From Latin cōmoedia, from Ancient Greek κωμῳδία (kōmōidía).

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /koˈmedja/ [koˈme.ð̞ja]
  • Rhymes: -edja
  • Syllabification: co‧me‧dia

Noun

[edit]

comedia f (plural comedias)

  1. (drama) comedy
    Antonym: tragedia
  2. comedy (entertainment)
  3. soap opera
    Synonyms: culebrón, telenovela

Derived terms

[edit]
  • comedia de capa y espada
  • comedia de costumbres
  • comedia de enredo
  • comedia de figurón
  • comedia de magia
  • comedia de situación
  • comedia del arte
  • comedia dramática
  • comedia musical
  • comedia negra
  • comediante
  • corral de comedias
  • hacer la comedia

Related terms

[edit]
  • cómico
  • tragicomedia

Further reading

[edit]
  • “comedia”, in Diccionario de la lengua española [Dictionary of the Spanish Language] (in Spanish), online version 23.8.1, Royal Spanish Academy [Spanish: Real Academia Española], 15 December 2025

comedia f (plural comedie)
